title: Elon Musk and Y Combinator President on Thinking for the Future - FULL CONVERSATION
summary: A Vanity Fair Summit conversation between Elon Musk and Sam Altman, moderated by Andrew Ross Sorkin. They discuss the future of technology, including AI and the simulation hypothesis.
why: Cited mainly as a source for what Musk and Altman said, notably their musings on the simulation hypothesis and the Fermi paradox, and as evidence of Musk's YC ties.

quote.text: Sam Altman and Elon Musk ponder whether we're all living in a simulation, as an explanation to the Fermi Paradox.
